mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past quarter signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline by more than 100,000 in the past month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decline > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between UNRATE and PAYEMS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% and real final sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 1% over the past quarter, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 10% and RSAFS decline > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in the past month, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) during tightening cycles.
